capabilities: Draw the notes of a base as an interactive graph
Choose the link source (all links, note body, or link properties)
Turn linked headings and blocks into separate nodes
Size and color nodes by property and color links by relation (Pro)
Export the graph to PNG or SVG (Pro)
extras: Freemium: core features are free with no note limit; Pro features require a $5/month or $15 one-time GitHub Sponsors payment, with device-flow sign-in that checks sponsorship (no vault data sent, no telemetry). After updates it opens a 'What's new' tab that promotes other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (can be disabled). Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later; the base row limit (e.g. first 100 results) caps the node count.
intentEvidence: The core graph shows the vault or one note. Bases Link Graph uses the filters of a base.
problem: The core graph view shows the whole vault or a single note, so there is no graph limited to the filtered set of notes a base selects.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike (Pro only)

summary: Adds a Link graph view type to Bases that draws the notes a base selects as nodes with directed links, heading nodes, and hover cards.
